# SOMA-SQL: Resolving Multi-Source Ambiguity in NL-to-SQL via Synthetic Log and Execution Probing

[All reading notes](../reading-notes.md) · [Catalog entry](../README.md#soma-sql)

**Full paper read · 2026-11-09**

[Original source](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2606.11424v1) · arXiv:2606.11424v1, 9 June 2026

**Reading coverage:** All 34 pages: sections 1–6, references, Appendices A–M, both algorithms, complete prompts, proof and end-to-end example; Figure 1 visually inspected.

## Research question

Underspecified intent, overlapping schema meanings and missing business context can produce plausible but semantically misaligned SQL.

## Method

The system creates ten plan-generate-critique candidates, derives ambiguity dimensions from disagreement and a taxonomy, executes targeted probes and repairs a selected seed. Optional synthetic clarification examples are generated from SQL-log anchors and retrieved into generation.

## Evaluation

Three backbones are compared with AutoLink and DeepEye-SQL on five benchmark partitions, plus a 300-example AMBROSIA study. Separate experiments add synthetic logs derived from provided benchmark gold SQLs. Fifty artifact-complete Spider cases receive a model-judge audit of probe grounding, resolution and repair.

## What the results support

No-log execution accuracy improves across the reported settings, and probing recovers cases missed by candidate selection. The synthetic-log condition improves further, but has different supervision. The AMBROSIA result measures the chosen execution outcome, not comprehensive interpretation coverage or user-validated intent recovery.

## Limits and qualifications

The paper does not clearly establish a disjoint historical-log/evaluation split for gold-derived clarifications. Larger or more coherent probe results do not identify a user’s unstated preference. The information-theoretic proposition assumes a conditional Markov relation and gives an upper bound, not an empirical guarantee of correct clarification. Candidate diversity, judge validity and added inference cost remain boundaries.

## Relevance to reliable Text-to-SQL

A useful autonomous probing design, provided evidence about database feasibility is distinguished from evidence of intended business meaning and gold-derived supervision is reported separately.

These are interpretations checked against the source, not verbatim quotations attributed to its authors.
